recommendedAction: Keep every sparse bit false. Do not enable Mesa 26.2 pan/kmod sparse on mali_kbase. Next phase is P23 compliance matrix, not sparse implementation.

reserveVA.vulkan: userspace VA heap via panvk_as_alloc for SPARSE_BINDING resources
reserveVA.kbase: KBASE_IOCTL_MEM_ALLOC / MEM_ALLOC_EX va_pages vs commit_pages; SAME_VA kernel-chosen VA

mapPages.vulkan: vkQueueBindSparse maps an existing memory object into a resource VA range
mapPages.kbase: MEM_ALLOC commit_pages or MEM_COMMIT on one growable region; no explicit-VA MAP

unmapPages.vulkan: bind VK_NULL_HANDLE or UNMAP / MAP_SPARSE blackhole punches a hole
unmapPages.kbase: MEM_COMMIT shrinks from the end; MEM_FREE / munmap destroys the whole region

rebindPages.vulkan: replace backing of a VA subrange with a different memory object
rebindPages.kbase: no ioctl maps a different handle into an existing subrange

aliasMappings.vulkan: sparseResidencyAliased: same pages in more than one sparse resource VA
aliasMappings.kbase: MEM_ALIAS creates a new kernel-chosen read-mostly VA; ring-buffer helper only

bufferSparseBind.vulkan: panvk_async_bind MAP at buffer device address + offset
bufferSparseBind.kbase: kbase_kmod_vm_bind rejects any MAP whose va.start is not the alloc-time VA

imageOpaqueBind.vulkan: VkSparseImageOpaqueMemoryBindInfo over the image VA range
imageOpaqueBind.kbase: same explicit-VA MAP requirement as buffers

imageSparseBind.kbase: 4 KiB page commit of one region from the front; no tile-at-offset map

pageGranularity.vulkan: 64 KiB standard sparse block; 4 KiB pages would be fine if MAP existed
pageGranularity.kbase: 4 KiB pages; ALLOC_ON_FAULT grows in 2 MiB extensions

faultBehavior.vulkan: unbacked pages are blackhole or device-lost; not JIT growth
faultBehavior.kbase: GROW_ON_GPF commits extension pages on fault; hole access is a GPU fault

queueOrdering.kbase: CSF CS queues only; BIND family is a lost-queue stub

synchronization.kbase: ASYNC vm_bind returns -1; no DRM syncobj

backendComparison.upstreamPanKmodSparse: Panthor DRM_IOCTL_PANTHOR_VM_BIND, MAP_SPARSE from panthor uAPI 1.9, panvk_async_bind.c
backendComparison.thisTree: custom mali_kbase backend; SAME_VA; vm_bind is bookkeeping
backendComparison.supportedVmOpFlags: unset on kbase; PAN_KMOD_VM_OP_OP_MAP_SPARSE only set by panthor_kmod.c
